title: Dacy's Totem Crafting Recipe
description: This data-pack adds a totem crafting recipe, This is designed for any survival playthrough due to the crafting recipe's difficulty.
body:
This data-pack adds a recipe for one of the most wanted items in the game, the Totem Of Undying, crafted like this:

![Totem crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b162e6a848d53f2c904b9b132fabe3b0a54002cf.png)

Once crafted the totem of undying goes into your inventory, This saves you the time to get to a woodland mansion and risk your life for it, It's also designed for servers/economy servers to make totems both hard and easy to get without them being very difficult to obtain.
